title: Austin Expands Zoning for Major Highway
summary:
*   **New Zoning Category:** Austin created a new "Fifth Height and Area District," expanding the city's zoning regulations from four to five distinct categories.
*   **Future Highway Development:** This new zoning designation was specifically applied to properties bordering the planned Interregional Highway (now I-35) between Manor Road and the northern city limits.
*   **Impact on Building Rules:** The change will govern building heights and lot coverage for land along this critical new transportation corridor, shaping its future development.
